chunks: 1712 - And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Whoever is certain of recompense, his soul becomes generous in spending.”
And Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: “And whatever you spend of anything, He replaces it, and He is the best of providers.”

key_terms.بِالْخَلَفِ: of divine replacement or compensation for what is spent

ai.seo_question: How does certainty in Allah’s provision encourage generosity and spending in His cause?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that certainty in Allah’s replacement and recompense makes a person generous in spending. The cited Qur’anic verse reinforces that whatever is spent, Allah replaces it, and that He is the best of providers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1712 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said: "Whoever is certain of compensation (from Allah (swt)), his soul will be generous in spending."
And Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: "And whatever you spend of anything [in His cause], He will replace it; and He is the best of providers.".
